description: This Java class 'OrderTotalSummary' models the summary of order totals, including subtotal, total, tax total, and a list of other associated fees such as taxes and shipping. It serves as a data transfer object (DTO) used to encapsulate order cost breakdowns.

classes.name: OrderTotalSummary
classes.description: Encapsulates the total calculation details of an order, including subtotal, total amount, taxes, and other fees.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Returns the subtotal amount for the order.

methods.name: setSubTotal
methods.description: Sets the subtotal amount for the order.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total amount for the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total amount for the order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of additional fee details (taxes, shipping, etc.).

methods.name: setTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of additional fee details.
